cause.finding: Settings auth intentionally accepts a null active organization when callers expect null. The admin sign-in path passed the stored organizationId through that permissive Settings check, and Scrape reused the resulting null identity for both its warm and post-reload checks.
cause.reproduction: Before the fix, `node --test tests/browser/settings-native-auth-driver.test.mjs` failed the new Scrape strictness assertion: expected false for valid admin identity plus organizationId=null and organizationSelected=false, received true. The same identity remains true under the default Settings contract.
alternatives_ruled_out: The member selector is not missing: its existing exact visible-option path selects Matrx's Org and verifies the storage UUID/name.
The defect is not in product organization resolution; it is the acceptance driver's reuse of Settings' nullable matcher for a Scrape case that requires explicit selection.

change.behavior: Settings retains its default null-organization contract. Scrape now explicitly selects the existing approved member-test organization using the shared picker before warm controls, requires a UUID plus the exact rendered/stored Matrx's Org name, and verifies that same selected organization identity after extension reload. The required path is used for both authenticated modes; guest stays outside it. No first-membership, account-default, or invented organization fallback was added.
change.receipt_privacy: Organization IDs and account identity values remain out of the receipt; it records only selection and verification booleans.

verification.red: Before the implementation, the new null-admin strictness assertion failed with `true !== false` at the expected predicate boundary.
verification.green: `node --test tests/browser/settings-native-auth-driver.test.mjs tests/browser/scrape-native-selection.test.mjs` passed 7 tests, 0 failed. The focused assertions cover null refusal in Scrape, mismatched label and ID refusal, approved organization acceptance for admin and member, Settings null-org preservation, and the existing default guest selection contract.
verification.native: Not run; run 37227042493 was already dispatched before this change and was left untouched. A new admin native run requires parent review first.

limits: No browser/native acceptance, build, release, database read, or secret access was performed.
The admin account's live availability of the approved Matrx's Org option and persistence across a real extension reload remain unverified until a separately approved native run.
This is an acceptance-harness correction and makes no Scrape product-health claim.
